en: Marks the Scarlet Spin throw that spent Fragrant Song, so the Resonances that throw summons crit with it. Every throw clears and re-primes this at its own start, which scopes it to one throw even though the next throw starts before this one's Resonances land. The duration only has to outlive the throw's own Resonances; scoping comes from the clear, not the expiry.
zh-Hans: 标记消耗了芳歌的那一次红消香断投掷，使该次投掷召唤的共鸣也随之会心。每次投掷开始时都会清除并重新挂上此标记，因此即使下一次投掷在本次投掷的共鸣命中前就已开始，它也只作用于单次投掷。持续时间只需长于该次投掷自身的共鸣；作用范围由清除来限定，而非依赖到期失效。

en: A summoned world object, not a stat buff. One exists per player: a new summon replaces the previous one rather than accumulating, and it expires after five seconds.
zh-Hans: 召唤出的场景物件，而非属性增益。每名玩家同时只存在一把：新召唤的会替换上一把，不会累积，且5秒后消失。

en: Counts returning umbrella throws since the last summon. Scarlet Spin primes this to two, so the first returning throw reaches the cap of three and summons, and the next summons fall on the fourth, seventh, tenth and thirteenth throw of that cast. Reaching the cap consumes the count so the next three throws are counted again.
zh-Hans: 统计自上次召唤以来的回旋伞投掷次数。红消香断会将此计数预置为2，因此第一次回旋伞投掷即达到3的上限并触发召唤，之后的召唤分别落在该次施放的第4、7、10、13次投掷。达到上限会消耗计数，随后的3次投掷重新计数。
